test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the letter-cluster that is different.
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54c9d52205610f923e1e91b9920dcb4c09ca0ead56ef220130741de93e664bcf.png] 

1) DSE - There is at least one vowel i.e 'E'.

2) MMV - There is no vowel.

3) LPU - There is at least one vowel i.e 'U'.

4) AMU - There are two vowels i.e 'A' and 'U'.

Thus, Out of the four letter clusters only second option doesn't have a vowel in it.

Hence, **"MMV"** is the correct answer.
